release: Newsgroup Media Filters & Bulk Queue Reliability
name: Newsgroup Media Filters & Bulk Queue Reliability
changes: Uses the same multipart/header reconstruction for Images, Video, Images + Video, and All Posts; probes obfuscated filenames with a bounded budget in media views.
Makes All Posts ordinary row clicks additive/toggle selections, with Shift-click ranges.
Submits unrelated selected files as individual SABnzbd jobs, preserving true release packages as single jobs.
Handles partial queue failures without silently dropping selected files.
regression_guards: Preserves v3.7.13 deferred-preview terminal cleanup and image-integrity suppression.
Preserves v3.7.14 history-only Remove all completed.
Preserves SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, Automation, and managed updates.
preserved: v3.7.14 Completed Remove All, existing user data, non-media downloads, native helper, all themes and published installers unchanged.
